Yesterday, I delivered $750,000 to the @Columbia  Community Mental Wellness Corps.

Our community deserves access to timely, effective, culturally relevant mental healthcare—and with this money, now they'll have access to it. https://t.co/JWVeNXzExZ

Capitol Police officers protect Members, staff, and visitors and deserve our support. Watch at 11 AM as I join @AppropsDems to mark up a bill that increases funding to hire officers, improve training, and bolster wellness support for these officers: https://t.co/sEHYQlclC4

In the wealthiest country in the world, no American should go hungry. Watch today at 10AM as I join @AppropsDems to mark up a funding bill that tackles hunger and nutrition insecurity with funding for programs like WIC, SNAP, and school meals https://t.co/hs0255LNHo
With the rising monkeypox cases in NYC, please see below for information regarding treatment facilities and how to contact a local clinic. https://t.co/Q9XmYMOA6f

As of July 25, 1,040 people in NYC have tested positive for monkeypox.

If you have symptoms, see a health provider for testing. If you do not have a provider, call 311 or search the NYC Health Map

To schedule a vaccination appointment by phone call 877-VAX-4NYC or 877-829-4692.

Let’s work together to keep our children safe. 

Here is the updated NYC COVID guidance for the 2022-2023 school year, and I strongly encourage all age-eligible individuals to get vaccinated: https://t.co/MqOJwGvtIt

Seniors deserve better care & less paperwork to get treatment. I’m supporting the Improving Seniors’ Timely Access to Care Act because it will:
✔️ Create an electronic #PriorAuth process
✔️ Require real-time decisions for common procedures
✔️ Improve transparency & accountability https://t.co/us5u9aDKIE
We will never cease in our support of patients and families, while boosting access to care and raising awareness of the importance of an early screening and treatment.

Today, we recognize, raise awareness for, and mourn those lost to the AIDS pandemic around the globe.

We mourn the more than 650,000 people who died last year due to HIV-related illness and vow to continue to promote education on prevention and treatment. Let’s #StopHIVTogether. https://t.co/vegjKEV8h4

This morning I tested positive for COVID-19 and am experiencing mild symptoms. I encourage anyone I have come in contact with to get tested.

Mask up everyone, especially during the holidays.

🚨 🚨 JAN. 15 is the DEADLINE to register for 2023 open enrollment #ACA coverage! 

Thanks to Congressional Democrats, care is now more affordable and accessible than ever before.

Sign up TODAY ⤵️ to enroll in coverage starting next month.

Had a very productive and informative discussion this afternoon with @NYCHealthSystem, Metropolitan Hospital.

I look forward to continuing to work together to ensure our healthcare professionals have the support they need to deliver the care patients deserve. https://t.co/8xqTAkIjrA

I am encouraged by @happymunkey420's dialogue exploring New York State's emerging cannabis industry, as well as the health and wellness benefits of cannabis.

Sign up to join our conversation below ⬇️
https://t.co/yNDqKvpMYg

I commend @POTUS for expanding health coverage for DACA recipients.

Dreamers are integral to our communities and economy. 

We must ensure they are able to live healthy and enriched lives as they continue to make our communities and nation a more vibrant place for all.

Pleasure joining the dedicated leaders of Henry J. Carter Specialty Hospital and Nursing Facility this morning. 

Thank you for all you do to afford equitable care and treatment for our community. https://t.co/Qa2R5AHLDX

Representing #TheBronx all the way up! 

Excited to welcome the Bronx’s own @FatJoe to the U.S. Capitol today at 2PM advocating for patients rights! 🔥 https://t.co/kK0IdBDjrW

Proud to introduce the Training and Nutrition Stability Act, which allows jobseekers in employment and training programs to maintain their nutrition benefits. 

This bipartisan bill will strengthen the SNAP program and ensure job seekers are not unfairly penalized. https://t.co/9pNhDT8ahC

We must protect SNAP and not slash benefits from hardworking Americans in employment and training programs.

That's why I am proud to lead the Training and Nutrition Stability Act to protect and bolster food security and good paying jobs. 

Cc. @amprog  

https://t.co/gY7OOwMVrz https://t.co/Q6RUDYTUjM

Thank you NY-13 health providers @NYCHealthSystem @nyphospital @BorikenHealth @NYAMNYC @MontefioreNYC and all who participated in today’s roundtable discussion.

Putting #PeopleOverPolitics and patients first! https://t.co/jXPqOvNs3B

Under @POTUS Biden’s leadership, we’ve:

✅ Reduced costs on insulin & healthcare premiums

✅ Reduced costs on airline fees

✅ Reduced costs on transportation with historic climate and infrastructure investments.

Now that’s Bidenomics in action.

Inflation 🟰down
Prescription costs 🟰down 
Health care premiums 🟰down 
Gas prices 🟰down.

Bidenomics isn’t just a wishlist—it’s the reality.

Our mission is clear: People. Over. Politics. Always. 💪🏽

There's an urgent crisis in NYC and my colleagues and I from the NY congressional delegation are continuing our push for more federal resources to support asylum seekers and new arrivals.

Thank you @patkiernan @NY1 for your ongoing coverage to address this humanitarian crisis. https://t.co/q9chQgw2Vj

#OTD 59 years ago today, the Food Stamp Act of 1964 was signed into law. 

Today, House Democrats continue to fight to ensure that this vital nutrition program is protected. 💫 https://t.co/DnEy36vyqi

Affordable, reliable health care coverage is available NOW at https://t.co/ZGmQUwYayZ. This year, 4 out of 5 Americans can find plans for less than $10 a month!

Mark your calendars! You have until December 15 to enroll in a plan that starts at the beginning of 2024. https://t.co/DLPM5yQsRe

Happening at 10AM.

WATCH LIVE coverage of my press conference today with @MTA @SecretaryPete @SenSchumer @GovKathyHochul and others to kickoff Phase II of the Second Avenue Subway in my district. 🚊🗽
